finding.headline: "The Dehydrated Mama"
finding.problem: "I'm thirsty all the time but I never remember to drink. My mouth is dry, my head hurts, and I worry my milk is dropping."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 30-yr-old breastfeeding mum who forgets water; urine dark; headaches; making less milk; needs hands-free-bottle habit + hydrating foods (watery fruits, soups).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Bonus / Free gift — "The 3-Litre Mama: Hydration Tracker + 15 Water-Rich Foods."". Verdict: PASSES (17/25)..
